name: Koepcke's Hermit
rangeDescription: Foothills of east slope of andes of peru
description: Large, orangish hermit from the Andean foothills. Light orange with a grayish-green back and a black mask typical of hermits.

name: Maracaibo Tody-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Coastal northwestern venezuela (zulia and falcón)
description: Tiny and faded-looking bird with long pointed bill and slender tail. Head gray with blackish forehead; upperparts greenish and underparts pale yellow; tail black.

name: Lavender Waxbill
rangeDescription: Senegambia to southwestern chad, northern cameroon, and central african republic
description: A tiny gray finch with a red tail and rump and a purplish bill. Male is bright silvery-gray all over with a pale throat and chest.

name: Long-billed White-eye
rangeDescription: Mountains of pohnpei (eastern caroline islands)
description: Bizarre and unique-looking white-eye, endemic to Pohnpei, in Micronesia’s Caroline Islands. Pale brownish-olive overall, with orange legs and a long curved bill; the two other white-eyes on the island, Pohnpei White-eye and Caroline Islands White-eye, are gray and yellow respectively, and both have short bills.

name: Short-legged Ground-Roller
rangeDescription: Dense rainforest of central and northeastern madagascar
description: Chunky, elaborately patterned, remarkably short-legged bird. White tail corners are conspicuous in flight.

name: Clapperton's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa (mali to sudan and ethiopia)
description: A medium-sized, pale francolin with large patches of red bare skin around the eyes. Heavily marked with black and pale buff on the back, neck, and underparts.

name: Aztec Rail
rangeDescription: Central mexico
description: Large, chickenlike rail of fresh marshes in highlands. Heard more often than seen; its main call is a rhythmic dry chatter.

name: Madagascar Flufftail
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern and northwestern madagascar
description: Tiny, skulking rail-like bird that is unlikely to be seen unless you’re expressly looking for it. The male is boldly red and black with white stripes, while the female is brownish and much plainer.

name: Diamond Dove
rangeDescription: Arid interior of australia
description: Tiny gray dove with a plain neck and chest, and an obvious red eyering. This species has tiny pale spots on folded wings.

name: Pel's Fishing-Owl
rangeDescription: Locally in riverine forest of sub-saharan africa
description: A giant, round-headed, ginger-rufous owl covered by dusky bars, spots, and chevrons. Quite shy; day-roosts are well-hidden in huge trees along permanent rivers and forested swamps with sluggish backwaters.

name: Taczanowski's Ground-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Páramo of peru and western bolivia (la paz to cochabamba)
description: Ashy gray flycatcher with a strong white eyebrow that perches upright on the ground. Found in high-elevation grasslands and pastures.

name: Madeira Chaffinch
rangeDescription: Madeira
description: Dapper little finch endemic to Madeira, where it inhabits a range of habitats, from forests to farmlands. Handsome, brightly colored male has a blue-grayish cowl, pale orangish face and breast, and a black-and-white wing pattern (colors muted in winter).

name: Spectacled Duck
rangeDescription: Mainly forested regions of southern argentina and chile
description: A handsome, generally uncommon, and rather shy duck of quiet vegetated lakes, forested rivers, and marshy wetlands; no similar species in range. Usually found in pairs or family groups, sometimes associating with other ducks but as often slightly separate.

name: Blue-moustached Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Mali and sierra leone to cameroon (douala)
description: An easily overlooked forest bee-eater of West and Central Africa, often found in the forest interior and near forest edge or tree-fall gaps. Dark overall, with a bluish to blue-purple head, belly, and tail, a red throat, a dark eye-line, and a reddish back.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Long-tailed Fiscal
rangeDescription: Dry thornscrub of southern somalia to kenya and northeastern tanzania
description: A large black-and-white fiscal with a long tail. Note the small white patch at the front of the wing and the white rump, both of which are conspicuous in flight.

name: White-chested Alethe
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern tanzania to northern malawi and south-central mozambique
description: Large, chunky robin with a reddish-brown back, a dark face, and bright white underparts. Found in the understory of forest: exclusively montane forest in the northern part of the range, but found down to sea level in the south.

name: Brown Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Bamboo forest of nepal to southeastern tibet, southwestern china, and northeastern myanmar
description: Dark brown parrotbill with a stout yellow bill and an arching black eyebrow. Like many other parrotbills, shows a strong affinity for high-elevation bamboo thickets, in which it moves about noisily in small flocks.

name: Plumbeous Ibis
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern brazil to bolivia, paraguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Distinctive gray ibis with a white forehead and bushy crest. Favors marshes, rice fields, and ponds, but also occurs in grassland, pastures, and savanna.

name: Tapajos Antpitta
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil, south of the amazon river, from the right (east) bank of the rio madeira to the upper rio xingu
description: Retiring species, almost tailless with very long robust legs. Has a reddish brown-back and white underparts streaked olive-gray.

name: Mariana Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Mariana islands (saipan, tinian, agiguan, rota, and guam)
description: A spectacularly colorful dove with a bright green body, an orange belly, a dark chest band, a bright silver neck and chest, a slim white eyebrow, and a striking magenta forehead. Wings have dark splodges on them.
